She holds up a sheet of paper that shows a photo of another woman and lists the airtime several news networks dedicated to her story. The video ends with the White House logo on a black screen.

on_screen_text.text: Sheridan Gorman’s life was worth far more than 23 seconds on cable tv.
Mainstream Media Won’t Cover the Murder of a Young Woman by an Illegal Alien

SHERIDAN GORMAN
[logo] ABC NEWS 1 MINUTE 19 SECONDS
[logo] CBS 2 MINUTES 1 SECOND
[logo] NBC NEWS 23 SECONDS

spoken_summary: A White House official speaks about the murder of Sheridan Gorman, a young woman in Chicago, allegedly by an "illegal alien from Venezuela." She calls it "despicable" that Democrats are trying to defund the agency responsible for deportations. She also criticizes the mainstream media for insufficient coverage of the case, holding up a document showing that ABC News, CBS, and NBC devoted very little time to the story, with NBC giving it only "23 seconds."
central_claim: The Democratic Party and the mainstream media are failing to protect and value American lives, as evidenced by their responses to the murder of Sheridan Gorman by an undocumented immigrant.
intended_effect: To provoke anger towards Democrats and the media, generate fear about immigration, and build support for the administration's policies.
uncertainty_flags: The identity of the female official speaking is not provided.
